cccma_ppp.generic.logger module

cccma_ppp.generic.logger.setup_logger(name='trainer', log_dir=None, rank=0, level=20)[source]

Create and configure a logger for training.

Parameters:

  • name (str, optional) – Name of the logger.

  • log_dir (str or pathlib.Path or None, optional) – Directory where log file will be saved. If None, falls back to environment variable GLOBAL_LOG_DIR.

  • rank (int, optional) – Process rank. Logging is only enabled for the root process (rank 0).

  • level (int, optional) – Logging level (e.g., logging.INFO, logging.DEBUG).

Returns:

Configured logger instance.

Return type:

logging.Logger
